page.title: Connectors
page.empty: No connectors yet. Add one to start reading a service.

activity.title: Activity
activity.empty: Syncs that record something or fail show up here.

deleteBody.atlassian: {{name}} and its Atlassian account are removed, along with any action item links made through it. The token stays valid on Atlassian until you revoke it there. What it recorded stays on the timeline.
deleteBody.github: {{name}} and its GitHub account are removed, along with any coding session or action item link that uses its token. The token stays valid on GitHub until you revoke it there.
deleteBody.browser: {{name}} and its browser are removed, signing the browser out of everything it was signed in to on this host. What it recorded stays on the timeline.
deleteBody.token: {{name}} and its key are removed. The key stays valid with its provider until you revoke it there. What it recorded stays on the timeline.

jira.name: Jira
jira.description: Issues on a Jira Cloud site, bounded to the projects and boards you pick, read with an Atlassian API token.

confluence.name: Confluence
confluence.description: Pages and comments in the spaces you pick, read with an Atlassian API token.

github.name: GitHub
github.description: Issues and pull requests, read through a personal access token.

outlook.name: Outlook
outlook.description: Your Outlook inbox, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Reading never marks your mail read.

gmail.name: Gmail
gmail.description: Your Gmail inbox, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Reading never marks your mail read.

teams.name: Teams
teams.description: Your Teams chats and channels, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Unread chats, mentions, and replies in your threads land in your inbox.

fireflies.name: Fireflies
fireflies.description: Your recorded meetings, read with your Fireflies API key and cut into segments on each project's timeline.

slack.name: Slack
slack.description: Your Slack workspaces, read through a browser Elysium runs, which you sign in to once. Direct messages, mentions, and thread replies land in your inbox.

youtrack.name: YouTrack
youtrack.description: Issues and comments on a YouTrack Cloud site, read with your own permanent token.

labels.allowlist_reachable: Reach the chosen projects and boards

counts.sample_comments_other: {{count, compact}} comments on the newest issue

reasons.fine_grained_scopes: GitHub does not report a fine-grained token's permissions.
reasons.no_repositories: The token reaches no repository to sample.
reasons.no_projects_allowed: Allow at least one project to search it.
reasons.allowlist_unresolved: Couldn't confirm which projects and boards it may read. Run the checks again.
reasons.sample_unread: The sample could not be read. Run the checks again.
reasons.browser_not_running: The browser is not running. Start it over, then run the checks again.
reasons.signed_out: The service is asking you to sign in again.
reasons.mailbox_not_open: Open the mailbox in the browser, then run the checks again.
reasons.teams_not_open: Teams is not open in the browser yet. Elysium opened it; run the checks again once it has loaded.
reasons.teams_store_not_found: Teams is open, but its chats were not found. Open a chat, then run the checks again.
reasons.no_messages: The inbox shows no messages to sample.
reasons.no_meetings: No meeting in the last two weeks to sample.
reasons.meeting_unavailable: The newest meeting is still being processed. Run the checks again later.
reasons.spaces_unresolved: Couldn't confirm the chosen spaces. Run the checks again.
reasons.no_spaces_chosen: Choose at least one space to search it.
reasons.slack_not_open: No tab in the browser shows Slack. Elysium opened one; run the checks again in a moment.
reasons.no_workspace_reached: Sign the browser in to one of the chosen workspaces.
reasons.no_conversations: No conversation it reads has a message to sample.
reasons.projects_unreachable: The token reaches none of the chosen projects. Choose ones it can reach.
reasons.no_issues: The chosen projects have no issue to sample.

detail.missing: This connector does not exist, or it is not yours.

form.browserSignIn: Elysium opens {{name}} in a browser of its own. You sign in once, on the real page, and it stays signed in.
form.requiredFailed: A required check failed. Fix it, or create the connector anyway and come back to it.

errors.browserPortsExhausted: Every browser this host can stream is in use. Remove a connector read through a browser first.
